english.title: Allow a vehicle / animal / thing to be on Luton Airport after a requirement to remove it / presence forbidden
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) allowed

(A)_[a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(B)_[an animal, namely **(..SPECIFY THE ANIMAL..),]_
(C)_[**(..SPECIFY THE THING..)]_

to be on Luton Airport

(D)_[after having been required to remove it]_
(E)_[after its presence on the airport had been forbidden]_

by an airport official or a constable having reasonable grounds to believe that its presence had been responsible for or about to be responsible for a byelaw or criminal offence
english.legislation: Contrary to Byelaws 2.22 and 7.2 of the London Luton Airport Byelaws 2005.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and place
allowed a vehicle / animal thing
to be on Luton Airport
after having been required to remove it OR
after its presence on the airport had been forbidden
by an airport official / PC having reasonable grounds to believe
that its presence had been responsible for / about to be responsible for
a byelaw / criminal offence
